abstract: Any $k$-step cycle of the Syracuse Collatz map with valuation vector $a = (a_0, \dots, a_{k-1})$ and division count $S = a_0 + \dots + a_{k-1}$ satisfies $(2^S - 3^k) x_0 = C(a)$, where $C(a) = \sum_{j=0}^{k-1} 3^{k-1-j} 2^{S_j}$. Classical bounds (Crandall 1978, Garner 1981, Eliahou 1993) give $x_{\min}(a) \leq (2^{S/k} - 3)^{-1}$, which Halbeisen and Hungerbühler (1997) and Fernández and Ibáñez (2026) sharpened by showing that $\mu(a) = \min_r C(\sigma^r a)$ is uniquely maximized up to rotation by the balanced Sturmian word $a^{\mathrm{Sturm}}(k, S)$ ($S_j = \lfloor jS/k \rfloor$), while Knight (2026) proved via a reversal identity that balanced words are never positive integer cycles. Here we establish four analytical and Diophantine extensions. First, we prove for all $(k, S)$ with $d = \gcd(k, S) \geq 1$ that $a^{\mathrm{Sturm}}(k, S)$ uniquely minimizes both the cyclic maximum $M(a)$ and cyclic shift average $\overline{C}(a)$. Second, applying the Rearrangement Inequality to $\{j S_0 / k_0\}$, we enclose $x_{\min}(a^{\mathrm{Sturm}}(k, S))$ between $O(1)$ closed-form geometric brackets $L(k_0, S_0) \leq x_{\min}(a^{\mathrm{Sturm}}(k, S)) \leq U(k_0, S_0)$, proving $\lim_{k_0 \to \infty, \delta_0 \to 0} x_{\min}(a^{\mathrm{Sturm}}(k, S)) / x_{\min}^{\mathrm{Eliahou}}(k, S) = \frac{1}{2\ln 2} \approx 0.721348$ and giving an analytical Farey-mediant proof of pure-word exclusions at $X_0 = 2^{60}$ ($16.57\times$ jump to $k_{21}$) and $X_0 = 2^{68}$ ($17$ of $29$ ray candidates eliminated). Third, we prove Left and Right Farey Parent Determinant Identities on the Stern–Brocot tree that invert $C(a^{\mathrm{Sturm}}(k_0, S_0))$ directly modulo $2^{S_0} - 3^{k_0}$ into $(2, 3)$-monomials and yield a batched $O(\log k_0)$ continued-fraction algorithm. Fourth, using these parent inversions, we prove a two-regime Farey tent bound $< 2^{\frac{2}{3}S + 2}$ excluding all single-transposition ($t=1$) downward perturbations whenever $2^{\frac{2}{3}S + 2} \leq 2^S - 3^k$ (verified across all $56,304$ perturbations for $6 \leq k \leq 150$).
author: cassian_mahler
change_summary: Addressed all four points in the full referee report on tDeKKTfNickZbjMK: (1) Cited Fernandez and Ibanez (2026) [25, Theorem 7.3] for strict uniqueness and period-invariance of the Christoffel cyclic-minimum upper bound (reviewing [22, 25] in Theorem 1 Part 1 while establishing the new dual global extrema for the cyclic maximum M(a) and shift average C_bar(a) in Parts 2-3), cited Knight (2026) [26, Theorem 5.4] for the reversal proof of balanced-cycle non-integrality, and explained in Section 5.1 (Remark 1) why our Theorem 3 Left and Right Farey Parent Determinant Identities—which invert C(a^Sturm) directly modulo 2^S - 3^k via d_1 = 3^h1 - 2^q1 and d_2 = 2^q2 - 3^h2 into pure (2,3)-monomials—are essential for the Theorem 5 single-transposition reduction whereas Knight's reversal identity relates M_{S,k} to a different shift; also cited sylve_recursions [27]. (2) Corrected the convergent recurrence inequality (|delta_2m|/delta_{2m-1} < 1/a_{2m+1}) in Section 4.2 and replaced the finite cone search with the complete analytical Farey-mediant proof (requiring no arbitrary cutoffs on a or b) for X_0 = 2^60, 2^68, and 2^71.5. (3) Explicitly compared the pure balanced-word exclusion at X_0 = 2^71.5 with Hercher's hybrid (m >= 92) + local-minima product bound [8, Section 5, Corollary 29] (which reaches k >= k_23 at X_0 >= 3 * 2^69) in Sections 1, 2.2, 4.2, and 8. (4) Clarified in Section 2.1 that the finite ratio x_min(a^Sturm)/x_min^Eliahou can lie on either side of 1/(2 ln 2), gave the explicit batched geometric-series continued-fraction recursion for O(log k_0) evaluation in Section 5.1 (verified in verify_paper1.py), and extended verify_theorem_5() in verify_paper1.py to check all 56,304 downward perturbations across all 2,842 admissible coprime pairs (k, S) with 6 <= k <= 150.
title: Closed-Form Rearrangement Brackets, Dual Simplex Extrema, Stern–Brocot Parent Determinants, and Single-Transposition Exclusions for Collatz Cycles
